purpose: Use expanded samples from the same six scenes for matched control and first-decoder width recovery, after scoring but before any candidate tuning run
amendment: The initial experiment specified the 32-image training and 16-image tuning manifest. A larger bounded acquisition succeeded after the 32-image ablation scan; use the expanded 128-image training and 64-image tuning manifest for all control and candidate recovery runs. The ablation ranking remains from the original 32 training images. The two samples per scene set shares a subset of images, and no tuning results from the new scenes were inspected when making this change.
limitations: Four training and two tuning scenes, correlated frames, same first scene in each shard, unknown evaluation scene identities; no Orin latency claim.
